name: spotify-claude-code-mod
description: Claude Code mod for Spotify: control the Spotify desktop app from Claude Code on macOS: now playing with progress, play/pause/next/previous, volume, shuffle, repeat, play a Spotify link or search for a track. Other plugins can use it through `$.spotify`. Fixed osascript scripts only, no daemon, no state file.

spotify_client_id.title: Spotify client ID
spotify_client_id.description: From an app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard; only needed for search

spotify_client_secret.title: Spotify client secret
spotify_client_secret.description: The secret of the same Spotify app; kept in secure storage and only ever sent to Spotify
